question.text: Assumptions of CAPM include all of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Investors can borrow/lend at risk-free rate
Different time horizons for each investor

explanation.text: **The Logic:** CAPM assumes SAME one-period time horizon for all investors. Different horizons would require different risk measures. **The Trap:** Relaxing many assumptions minimally changes CAPM predictions; horizon uniformity is a baseline assumption. **Cross-Exam Context:** CMT canon. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** CAPM's assumptions are unrealistic but predictions hold reasonably well — a testament to its robustness.
